title: Setting a Trap to Lure the Snake
next_chapter_hook: When that familiar figure emerged from the shadows, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—this face he knew all too well, yet should never appear at this moment.

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back by the window, his gaze piercing through the misty night to the Council Hall of the distant Tianqing Sect. That probing presence had vanished too suspiciously—not a panicked retreat after being discovered, but a calculated withdrawal with prior planning. This sensation of being outmaneuvered made him extremely uncomfortable, yet also increasingly convinced: there was more than one insider, and their level far exceeded his initial estimate. "Since the opponent enjoys playing chess..." A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips, "then let this waste teach them what it means to have a mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind."

dialogue.content: Bring someone, have this intelligence 'accidentally' delivered to the Xuanwu Sect. Remember, make it convincing, best if that fool Han Lie 'intercepts' it himself.

text.content: The trusted aide departed with the order, while Chen Ji slowly walked to the desk, his fingertips gently brushing over the yellowed fragment. The Tianji Record glowed faintly warm, as if warning him of something. He coldly smiled as five points of Heavenly Fate silently drained—this was the price for glimpsing three hours into the future. The images gradually clarified: tomorrow night at the hour of midnight, outside the Alliance Council Hall, there would be an assassination attempt against him. And the assassin... was someone he had never suspected... "Heh." Chen Ji laughed, but his eyes were ice-cold, "What a clever case of hiding in plain sight."

The next day, outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. A servant disciple secretly hid a sealed letter in the bushes, unaware that a black shadow passing overhead had observed everything. At the Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie received the 'intercepted' letter, glanced at it, and burst into laughter: "Chen Ji, that waste, actually dares to collude with the Demonic Path! Let's see how he dies now!" He eagerly gathered his men and marched grandly toward the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji, hiding in the shadows, watched this scene with an increasingly amused curve at the corner of his mouth.

choice.prompt: Han Lie has taken the bait, but Chen Ji needs to decide his next move—

choices.text: Watching Tigers Fight from the Mountain
choices.description: Wait for Han Lie to clash with the Sect Insider, then net them in the chaos
choices.visible_reward: Killing Two Birds with One Stone, Mutual Attrition
choices.risk_hint: If the Insider Escapes Early, Battle Results Will Be Significantly Reduced

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew into the shadows, watching with great interest as Han Lie led his men rushing into the Tianqing Sect, shouting and demanding his arrest. Alliance disciples were startled one after another, and at this moment, another figure quietly appeared at the side door of the Council Hall—the very insider revealed by the Tianji Record.

choices.description: Directly Confront Han Lie, Use Words to Goad Him into Revealing Weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Publicly Humiliate Han Lie, Gain Reputation
choices.risk_hint: If the Insider Notices, They May Change Their Plans

text.content: Chen Ji stepped out slowly, robes fluttering, wearing a panicked expression: "Brother Han, what is the meaning of this? I, Chen Ji, am utterly loyal to the Alliance—how could there be any collusion with the Demonic Path?" His voice was deliberately raised, drawing many surrounding disciples to watch. Han Lie coldly laughed and slapped the sealed letter onto Chen Ji's face.

The letter fell to the ground, Chen Ji picked it up, glanced at it, and actually laughed. That smile was light and casual, yet made Han Lie inexplicably uneasy. Just as he was about to speak, Chen Ji had already抢先道："Brother Han, do you recognize the handwriting in this letter?" Han Lie froze, frowning to examine it closely—the handwriting was crooked and slanted, clearly deliberately disguised. Just then, an exclamation came from the back of the crowd: "Isn't that... the handwriting of the Sect Master's personal guard?" At these words, everyone erupted in uproar.

dialogue.content: Nonsense! This is a frame-up! Chen Ji, you waste, stop confusing everyone here!

text.content: Chen Ji unhurriedly flicked his sleeves, wearing an innocent expression: "Brother Han, you're mistaken. I was merely curious—why would this frame-up specifically use the handwriting of the Sect Master's personal guard? Could it be... wanting to kill two birds with one stone, eliminating me while framing the Sect Master?" Before he finished speaking, the crowd erupted. Everyone whispered, their gazes shifting between Han Lie and the Council Hall. Han Lie's face alternated between green and white—he finally realized he had been tricked. This letter was Chen Ji's setup, and he, the堂堂 first genius of the Xuanwu Sect, had actively jumped into the trap!

dialogue.content: Fellow brothers and sisters, though my cultivation is weak, I know this letter is suspicious. Please look—" Chen Ji shifted his focus, pointing to a certain part of the letter, "This wax seal is clearly the unique secret method of the Xuanwu Sect. Brother Han, you wouldn't say we forged it ourselves at the Tianqing Sect, would you?

text.content: Han Lie's face turned completely dark. He lowered his head to look at that wax seal—it was indeed his sect's unique mark. Now even jumping into the Yellow River couldn't wash this clean—the 'secret letter' intercepted by a Xuanwu Sect disciple actually bore the Xuanwu Sect's own seal? Anyone looking at it would think Han Lie was behind this! "Chen Ji..." He squeezed these two words through gritted teeth, his eyes full of fury and disbelief. When did this waste become so formidable?

choice.prompt: Han Lie has fallen into a passive situation, but the real insider has yet to appear—

choices.description: Publicly Interrogate Han Lie, Make Him Lose All Face
choices.visible_cost: May Let the Real Insider Escape
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie Humiliated, Xuanwu Sect's Reputation in Tatters
choices.risk_hint: The Real Insider May Escape in the Chaos

text.content: Chen Ji laughed lightly and continued: "Brother Han, you came all this way to make accusations. Now the evidence points to yourself—how do you explain this? Could it be that a genius of the Xuanwu Sect is someone who can't tell right from wrong?" Suppressed laughter came from all around, Han Lie's face turning the color of pork liver.

choices.description: Stop Entangling with Han Lie, Directly Name the Real Insider in the Shadows
choices.visible_reward: Net Everyone at Once, Insider Has Nowhere to Hide
choices.risk_hint: If Judgment Is Wrong, Will Fall into an Awkward Situation

text.content: Just as everyone was laughing, Chen Ji's gaze quietly swept past Han Lie and landed on an inconspicuous figure at the side door of the Council Hall. He smiled faintly and said loudly: "Brother Zhou, since you've come, why not show yourself and have a chat? That letter... was indeed delivered to the Xuanwu Sect through your hands, wasn't it?"

That figure stiffened slightly, then slowly emerged from the shadows. It turned out to be Zhou Chen, deputy captain of the Tianqing Sect Master's personal guard—a person who was usually silent and unremarkable. Everyone was stunned. How did this waste know? Yet Chen Ji smiled increasinglycomposed. "Brother Zhou, you thought I was turning their scheme against them, setting this trap within a trap—the Xuanwu Sect was merely the visible piece, the real target... is you." He clapped his hands, and over a dozen Alliance Law Enforcement disciples rushed out from all directions, surrounding Zhou Chen completely.

dialogue.content: Brother Zhou, I don't care whom you serve. But you shouldn't have, of all things, pointed your schemes at me." Chen Ji stepped closer, gazing down at the surrounded Zhou Chen, "Speak—whose orders are these? Ling Yuan's, or that person's?

text.content: Zhou Chen's face twitched, then unexpectedly broke into laughter. That smile was eerie and cold, sending chills down everyone's spines. "Chen Ji... do you think you've won?" He bit his tongue sharply, spraying a mouthful of essence blood into the sky, forming a blood-red rune—it was a signal for Demonic Path forbidden techniques! In an instant, dark shadows surrounded the Council Hall on all sides, countless powerful auras erupted simultaneously! Chen Ji's expression finally changed—he hadn't expected the opponent to have a follow-up move, let alone one that came so quickly!

Chen Ji coldly swept his gaze across the dark figures emerging from all sides, yet his heart was ice-cold. However exquisite the setup was? The opponent clearly had preparations, even more thorough than he had imagined. This game of wits was never just a contest between him and Zhou Chen from the start—the person behind had too high a level, high enough that he had to re-examine the entire situation. But this wasn't the time for regret. He took a deep breath, spiritual energy began surging around him. Whoever the opponent was, since they dared to come, don't blame him for being impolite. "Everyone—" he announced, "Activate the Sect Protection Formation!"

However, just as the Sect Protection Formation activated, a massive crack split the sky. An elderly yet majestic voice descended from the rift: "No need, Chen Ji. This old man has come, wanting to see with my own eyes... how you plan to end this play." The voice fell, and a figure slowly descended from the crack—it was Ling Yuan, the long-vanished old Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect! Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, his heart掀起惊涛骇浪. He had laid such elaborate plans all this time, yet was still being led by the nose? Ling Yuan's lips held a meaningful smile, as if gazing at an ant that had fallen into his web.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, Chen Ji, did you think this old man didn't know about your little tricks? The Tianji Record Fragment... did you think this old man had been waiting for this day for how long?

text.content: Ling Yuan stood with hands behind his back, gazing down at Chen Ji from above, as if observing an ant that thought itself clever. "You thought setting this trap within a trap could lure out this old man? How naive." He lightly waved his hand, and the restraints on Zhou Chen dissolved on their own, "Zhou Chen is merely a discarded piece—the real chess game... began the moment you stepped into the Tianqing Sect." Chen Ji did not speak, merely quietly watching Ling Yuan, something churning in the depths of his eyes. He knew Ling Yuan spoke the truth—from the very beginning, he had been calculated against. But even so, he would not surrender束手就擒. "Ling Yuan..." he said softly, his voice terrifyingly calm, "You think you've already won?"

Just then, a crisp sword cry shattered the air. Su Qingyao arrived riding her sword, followed by dozens of Inner Sect disciples. Her gaze swept between Ling Yuan and Chen Ji, finally landing on Chen Ji. "Chen Ji, are you alright?" Her voice was somewhat urgent, a flash of worry flickering in her eyes. Chen Ji was slightly stunned, a complex emotion welling in his heart. This woman... appeared at critical moments yet again. Just as he was about to speak, Ling Yuan had already laughed coldly: "Girl Su, you've come to join the fun as well? Very well, today let these juniors witness what true disparity in strength looks like." He raised his hand, the heavens changed color, and a vast pressure like an ocean crashed down.
When that familiar figure emerged from the shadows, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—this face he knew all too well, yet should never appear at this moment.
